Job OverviewJoin ENPULSION as a Customer Success Engineer (f/m/x) and support our customers throughout their spacecraft missions - from pre-sales, to integration and testing, to on-orbit operations. You’ll act as the key technical partner, ensuring smooth product performance, clear communication, and successful mission outcomes in the fast-growing space industry.

Key responsibilities:
• Act as the main point of contact for project- and program management of key customers.
• Analyze customer requirements and develop compliance matrices to ensure alignment with customer needs and expectations.
• Provide technical support to the Sales team.
• Support customers with integration and operation of ENPULSION products.
• Provide technical support in the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT).
• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of ground support equipment.
• Manage and facilitate customer tests and workshops.
• Initiate, actively support and report on non-conformance processes and anomaly reviews in accordance with established processes.
• Analyze and review on-orbit telemetry, focusing on operator command sequences and thruster anomalies.
• Automate telemetry analysis with Python scripts.
• Recommend strategies and operational parameters based on telemetry and product performance.
• Provide on-orbit operations support to ensure products perform optimally in space.
• Deliver clear, concise, and well-written technical documentation.

Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week

Salary : The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2918,14 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Your profile
• Technical or scientific education (FH/University/UAS/HTL), ideally a Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or Mechanical Engineering.
• 3+ years of professional experience in aerospace or a related industry
• Understanding of electric propulsion systems used for satellite mobility is beneficial.
• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).
• Familiarity with space industry standards and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ECSS, ITAR).
• Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong ability to explain complex technical issues to customers clearly and concisely.
• Willingness to travel to customer facilities as needed.
• Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to independent work.
• Passionate about contributing to a fast-growing business and high-performing team.

Why us?At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include:
• 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
• Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
• Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options
• Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
• Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
• Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program
• Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
• FitFabrik Fitness Center
• Airport Health Center
• Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
• VIE Community App for news and deals

About usMeet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy!ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.

We are a deep-tech company that creates and produces internationally awarded smart glasses. Our headquarters is in Vienna, where we develop and manufacture both the hardware and the software of the smart glasses.

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Assembly Technician (m/f/x) - The Craft Hand Vienna 1010, fulltime

We build award-winning smart glasses in Vienna: hardware, firmware, software, all under one roof. Behind every device that ships is precise, careful, hands-on work, and that's exactly what this role is about. You'll be part of the team that turns components into finished products, working closely with engineers, quality assurance, and production to keep things moving and the standards high.

This is a role where your hands-on skill and attention to detail make a visible difference every single day.

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Hands-on assembly of components and devices across different stages of the production process

 * Material preparation, pre-assembly, cleaning, packaging, and warehouse support

 * Use hand and power tools to assemble products with precision and care

 * Inspect components and assemblies to ensure quality standards are met

 * Document and report any discrepancies in the assembly process

 * Collaborate with team members to meet production deadlines

 * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives on the production floor

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * Completed technical apprenticeship, ongoing or recently completed HTL, or relevant studies

 * Solid technical understanding and careful handling of small components and electronics

 * Manual dexterity and good hand-eye coordination

 * Familiarity with assembly processes, tools, and techniques

 * Attention to detail and a practical problem-solving mindset

 * Flexibility to support a wide range of tasks in production

 * Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies

 * Good communication skills in German and/or English

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €2.400 - €4.000 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built, from PCB to shipped device

 * International team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to be part of the team that makes smart glasses real?

We can't wait to meet you.

Making Future Reality - let's assemble it together.

Send us your application and let's take off together!

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry. 

The impact you'll make

At Lam, as a Material Program Manager (MPM), you play a pivotal role in driving supply chain success across development and product programs. You coordinate material and sourcing activities in cross-functional teams to ensure cost-effective, scalable, and risk-resilient supply solutions from early development through manufacturing readiness.Acting as a key interface between Engineering, Program Management, and suppliers, you help shape sourcing strategies that support innovation, speed, and ramp readiness as well as long-term operational excellence in Lam's global supply chain. 1 Materials Program Manager / Technischer Einkauf (all genders) Job-ID: 197415 I Work Location Model: On-site Flex I Arbeitsort: Salzburg I Work Country: Österreich

 * Define and drive program sourcing strategies and related sub-projects for direct materials, equipment, and services in collaboration with Engineering, Supplier Engineering, Production.

 * Perform cost analysis, volume planning, and supply-risk assessments for assigned programs and suppliers. 

 * Drive cost engineering, cost reduction, and manufacturing ramp readiness from supplier onboarding to serial release.

 * Partner closely with suppliers and Quality teams to resolve technical, quality, and manufacturability issues impacting cost, schedule, or scale-up readiness.

 * Define, document, and present program sourcing strategies to stakeholders and management, translating technical and commercial inputs into structured program updates (e.g. PowerPoint, program reviews).

Who we're looking for

 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, Business Engineering, or a related field, combined with minimujm 4 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, or technical procurement.

 * Excellent computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Excel,)

 * Communication skills, both written and verbal, in English and German.

 * Deep knowledge or experience in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or Materials Requirements Planning (MRP) systems such as Microsoft Business Central, SAP, Oracle, or other procurement related tools.

 * Exceptional interpersonal and influence skills.

Preferred qualifications

 * Experience in the semiconductor industry or other high-tech industries.

 * Prior experience in supply chain, technical procurement or similar functions.

 * Proven exposure to supplier onboarding, early risk assessment, and cross-functional alignment on specifications and manufacturability.
